# LTN ("Trust Decoheres") — top-level Python requirements  (conda env: qt, Python 3.11)
# Curated to MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN §2.1 + the quantum/eval needs of §2.2, §2.7, §2.8.
# Pinned to the versions validated by scripts/verify_env.py on 2026-07-12 (3x NVIDIA L40S).
# For the exact frozen graph of every transitive dependency, use env/requirements-lock.txt.
#
# NOTE on torch + CUDA: the default PyPI `torch==2.13.0` wheel bundles the CUDA 13.0
# runtime (cu130) — an exact match for this machine's NVIDIA driver 580.x / CUDA 13.0
# on the L40S (sm_89). Plain `pip install torch==2.13.0` is sufficient; no --index-url
# is required. If reproducing on a host with an older driver, pick a matching build from
# https://download.pytorch.org/whl (e.g. cu126) instead.

# --- deep learning / GPU ---
torch==2.13.0                 # cu130 build (bundled) — 3x L40S, sm_89
torch_geometric==2.8.0        # temporal graphs / message passing (KrausProp base)

# --- quantum stack ---
qiskit==2.5.0                 # coupling maps, backend configs (graph builder A4)
qiskit-ibm-runtime==0.47.0    # IBM fleet calibration harvester (A1) — longitudinal backbone
qiskit-aer==0.17.2            # optional local reality-check simulation
qutip==5.3.0                  # density-matrix / Lindblad reference for unit tests (§2.2)

# --- scientific / numerical ---
numpy==2.4.6
scipy==1.17.1
pandas==3.0.3
pyarrow==25.0.0               # parquet event lake
statsmodels==0.14.6           # ARIMA / EWMA baselines (E1)
scikit-learn==1.9.0           # AUROC/AUPRC, calibration (E3, E7)
properscoring==0.1            # CRPS — headline forecast metric & early-stop criterion
h5py==3.16.0                  # Google QEC datasets (HDF5)

# --- experiment tooling ---
optuna==4.9.0                 # 50-trial HPO budgets per baseline (B3)
wandb==0.28.0                 # experiment logging (CSV fallback ok)
pyyaml==6.0.3                 # exp/E*.yaml configs
matplotlib==3.11.0            # figures F1–F7
seaborn==0.13.2
zenodo_get==3.0.3             # Tier-1 dataset downloads (DAQEC, Google QEC, silicon)

# --- QEC data parsing (added 2026-07-13 for Google Zenodo loaders [DEV-7]) ---
stim==1.16.0                  # .stim circuits, .dem detector error models, .b8 shot data
pymatching==2.4.0             # MWPM decoding -> logical_error_per_round (E5 target)
sinter==1.16.0                # optional parallel decoding convenience

# --- notebooks / dev / CI ---
jupyterlab==4.6.1             # data-quality notebook (A6), data inventory
ipykernel                     # kernel `qt` registered for Jupyter
pytest==9.1.1                 # unit tests (each §2.2 guarantee)
pytest-cov
tqdm
requests

# --- NOT installed (optional PyG C/CUDA extensions) ---
# torch-scatter / torch-sparse / pyg-lib have no prebuilt wheels for torch 2.13 + cu130
# yet, and PyG core message passing (GCNConv, custom MessagePassing) works without them.
# Add later only if a scatter-heavy op needs acceleration, once wheels are published at
# https://data.pyg.org/whl/torch-2.13.0+cu130.html (or build from source against nvcc 13).
